messages:
maria: FYI noticed multiple A100 pools in us-west1 showing P2P disabled after the kernel+driver push this morning. Multi-GPU jobs reporting 20-40% slowdown. Anyone else?

deploy-bot: deploy: kernel=6.4.8, nvidia-driver=535.86 rolled to us-west1-prod at 2024-06-27T09:12:03Z

ashok: Seeing it on ded-gpu-pool-a100-{1,2,4}. Short perf test: nccl allreduce stalls, throughput drops. dmesg shows P2P disabled by driver.

leo: Quick grep from one node:
``n\$ dmesg | tail -n 20
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: P2P: BAR1 aperture size insufficient, disabling peer-to-peer on GPU 0000:af:00.0
[ 1234.567892] NVRM: PCI: BAR1 size 0x80000000 -> allocated 0x20000000
```
and lspci -vv shows ACS on the bridge. BAR1 allocation is smaller than our 6.1 canaries.

priya: We found kernel 6.4 changes PCI resource assignment heuristics on some HPE+Mellanox hosts. BAR1 can shrink, and the NVIDIA driver interprets that as insufficient, so it disables P2P.

maria: Action items immediate: (1) stop further 6.4.8+ driver rollouts to Ampere pools; (2) rollback canaries to previously known-good combo (kernel 6.1.x + driver 535.54); (3) add driver whitelist/blacklist in deployer; (4) collect logs for vendor escalation. Ashok, can you own rollback playbook?

ashok: On it. Rolling driver back on 3 canaries now. Early result: driver 535.54 restores P2P and NCCL throughput on canaries. I'll push a rollback runbook + automated dmesg check for "P2P disabled". :white_check_mark:

leo: I'll add BAR1 size and PCIe resource map metrics to node exporter and create a regression alert when BAR1 < expected threshold or P2P drops. Also scanning other regions for kernel 6.4 installs.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2024-1234: A100 P2P regressions after kernel/driver rollout 9 assigned to infra-ops. Priority: P1

priya: Heads-up: NCCL upstream threads mention PCIe ACS interactions; some driver/kernel combinations expose it. Eng-ML, add temporary fallback to gloo/ibverbs for latency-sensitive jobs and tag affected model runs so we can re-run once fixed.

eng-ml: Will scope quick fallback and add perf tags. Also will postpone large training runs in us-west1 until we confirm stability.

ashok: Rollback playbook draft pushed: steps include targeted driver revert, smoke tests (nccl_allreduce_micro, memchecker), dmesg scan, canary targets, and auto-rollback if P2P remains disabled.

maria: After we finish rollback and add metrics, escalate to NVIDIA + host vendor with collected logs (dmesg, lspci -vv, driver versions, kernel config). Also add BIOS/NIC firmware preflight check to ensure PCIe BAR1 settings. Sync in 30m. :eyes:
